analysis_steps.goal: Fit dust SED for Td, beta, L_TIR, SFR_IR

method.value: Optically thin modified blackbody with CMB correction fit to Herschel, ALMA, MAMBO photometry; chi2; integrate 8-1000 um

evidence.quote: By fitting modified-black body models corrected for the CMB effects to the photometry data, we obtain $T_{\rm d} = 50\pm2$ K and $\beta_{\rm d} = 1.8\pm0.1$ based on the $\chi^{2}$ statistics.

claims.hypothesis: Can [OIII] 88 um be detected in z~6 quasars?
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 8 observations of two quasars
claims.finding: Detections of [OIII] in quasars at z>6

evidence.quote: we successfully detect [Oiii] and the underlying dust continuum

claims.finding: J2310+1855 has lowest ratio at z>6

evidence.quote: the latter of which is the lowest among objects so far reported at $z>6$.

claims.hypothesis: Is there an [OIII] line deficit at high z?
claims.experiment: Compare L[OIII]/L_TIR vs L_TIR with literature
claims.result: anti-correlation, shifted to higher L_TIR than local
claims.finding: [OIII] deficit exists, shifted at high z

evidence.quote: we also find that the anti-correlation is shifted toward higher $L_{\rm TIR}$ value when compared to the local [Oiii] line deficit.

claims.experiment: Compare SFR_OIII and SFR_IR, sizes, FWHM with [CII]
claims.result: SFR_OIII ~5x SFR_IR in J2054; consistent within 2x in J2310
claims.finding: No strong evidence for AGN contamination of [OIII]

evidence.quote: there is no strong evidence that supports the AGN contamination to [Oiii] in the two objects in this study

why_this_data.value: Bright L_TIR, relatively lower z, avoids atmospheric absorption to secure detection

evidence.quote: To secure the [Oiii] line detection within reasonable ALMA integration times, we selected objects with (i) bright total infrared luminosities
